name: RakNetPacket.SetData
description: Replaces the data stored on a live RakNetPacket with a string, buffer, or array table of byte numbers. The packet ID is updated from the first byte, or 0 when the new data is empty.

parameters.name: packet
parameters.description: Live packet object passed to a RakNet hook or signal callback.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Replacement packet data. Array-table bytes must be numbers from 0 through 255.
